overview_description.description:
Impressively designed and easy to use, Alma provides the industry’s best student information system, including:  admissions, enrollment and registration, student demographics, attendance, advanced scheduling, discipline, grades, state reporting, custom report cards, parent portal, student portal, standards-based and traditional gradebook, reporting, custom form builder and much more.
One platform. Hundreds of features. Limitless insight.

product.name: Alma Student Information System (SIS)
product.description: A cloud-based platform that manages student data, attendance, grading, scheduling, and communication for K-12 educational institutions.

product.name: Navigator
product.description: An in-app implementation and onboarding tool that guides schools through the setup and migration process to Alma SIS with project management and progress tracking.

product.name: Alma Start
product.description: A configurable, mobile-optimized student registration and enrollment software that digitizes and streamlines admissions for schools and districts.

product.name: District Solutions Package
product.description: A suite of tools tailored for school districts including compliance reporting, advanced scheduling, fee management, and communication features.

product.name: Data Lab
product.description: A real-time analytics and reporting tool that provides insights into school operations and student data patterns.
